subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should room_event turns keep strict message-tool-only source delivery while using the session-stable visible-reply mode only for prompt/cache construction?
rationale: The docs intentionally keep ambient room events quiet, but the reported cache regression shows prompt construction needs a stable contract; choosing the permanent split versus a new config knob is a product/API decision.

options.title: Preserve Strict Delivery, Stabilize Prompts
options.body: Keep room events quiet at delivery and fix every prompt/cache path to use session-stable prompt facts.

options.title: Add A Room-Event Reply Knob
options.body: Introduce a separate room-event visible-reply setting with docs, schema, and upgrade proof if maintainers want configurable delivery semantics.

options.title: Document Strict Coupling Only
options.body: Document that room_event always implies message-tool-only prompts and accept the cache churn as intended behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve Strict Delivery, Stabilize Prompts
recommendation.body: Keep room events quiet at delivery and fix every prompt/cache path to use session-stable prompt facts.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about the group visible-reply contract introduced in the visible-replies feature history.
